glslang 16.5.0 (github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang): the parts armN64's build uses (`cmake/glslang.cmake`),
the GLSL front end and the SPIR-V back end. Licenses in `LICENSE.txt` and `LICENSES/`. `SPIRV/hex_float.h`
is armN64's (GPL-2.0-or-later) in place of SPIRV-Tools' Apache-2.0 `hex_float.h` and `bitutils.h`.
